title: iOS update tracker: latest version, dates and what's new
text:
TL;DR: The latest iOS update on Apple’s security page is iOS 27.2.1 and iPadOS 27.2.1, released on November 9, 2026, alongside iOS 26.7.3 and iOS 18.7.12 for older iPhones. We last checked on November 10, 2026.

Last updated: November 10, 2026.

## How iOS version numbers work

The first number is the major version, such as 27. A second number, such as 27.2, marks a larger update during the year, and a third number, such as 27.0.1, marks a small fix.

Apple also keeps updating older versions. iOS 26.7.3 is the iOS 26 update for iPhones that stay on iOS 26, and it was released on the same day as iOS 27.2.1.

## iOS 27.2.1 and iPadOS 27.2.1 (released November 9, 2026)

- Version number: iOS 27.2.1.
- Released: November 9, 2026.
- Security: Apple’s page lists security entries for this release. Open the source link for the full list.
- What it means for you: open Settings, General, Software Update and install it when it appears.

## iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2 (released October 26, 2026)

- What it is: the first larger update to iOS 27. Apple’s security page lists it for iPhone 11 and later.
- Version number: iOS 27.2.
- Released: October 26, 2026.
- What’s new: Siri AI gets changes, including more languages, along with smarter Messages suggestions and a redesigned Apple Music look, according to coverage of Apple’s release notes by 9to5Mac and Mac Observer.
- iPhone Duo: the update adds USB-C Apple Pencil support, per the same coverage.
- Not included: the redesigned Health app appeared in early betas but did not reach the final release. Apple is reported to plan it for later in 2026.
- Security: Apple’s page lists more than 160 security entries for this release and does not say that any issue is actively exploited. We break down where the fixes sit in our report on the iOS 27.2 security update.
- More detail: see our reports on the Siri Excluded Apps setting and the Shared Albums and SynthID changes.
- What it means for you: this update carries many security fixes, so install it when your iPhone offers it.

Source: About the security content of iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2.

## iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2 (released October 26, 2026)

- What it is: the security update for iPhones that stay on iOS 26. Apple’s page lists it for iPhone 11 and later.
- Version number: iOS 26.7.2.
- Released: October 26, 2026, the same day as iOS 27.2.
- Older iPhones: on the same day Apple released iOS 18.7.11 for the iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max and iPhone XR.
- Security: Apple’s page lists a long set of fixes and does not say that any issue is actively exploited.
- What it means for you: if you have not moved to iOS 27, this is the update to install.
